headline: Windsor Machines announces shareholders meeting via postal ballot
hook: Postal ballot notice issued to shareholders
summary: Windsor Machines Limited has informed the stock exchange regarding the issuance of a notice for a postal ballot. The company is seeking shareholder approval through this remote voting mechanism. Details regarding the specific resolutions proposed in the postal ballot were not disclosed in the initial filing. Retail investors holding shares in the company will need to review the formal notice for voting items.

headline: Vinay Bansod resigns as Executive Director of Windsor Machines
summary: Windsor Machines Limited has announced that Mr Vinay Bansod will step down from his position as Executive Director, effective October 15, 2026. The company informed the stock exchanges regarding this board-level departure. Retail investors in Windsor Machines should note this upcoming change in key managerial personnel.
why_it_matters: Board-level departure at Windsor Machines ahead in 2026

headline: Windsor Machines files 63rd AGM e-voting results and scrutinizer report
hook: Routine AGM resolutions pass at Windsor Machines
summary: Windsor Machines Limited has submitted the e-voting results and consolidated scrutinizer report for its 63rd Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026. All resolutions proposed at the meeting were placed before shareholders for voting. Routine annual compliance filings like this have no material impact on the company's financial position or stock price. Indian retail shareholders can note the completion of corporate governance formalities for the year.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no impact on your portfolio.
